name: ChassistantGPT
summary: Runs ChatGPT as a hands-free voice assistant in the background of the browser. You start it with a spoken trigger phrase or a keyboard shortcut, and it supports more than 60 languages and dialects.
audience: People who want to talk to ChatGPT by voice without opening the chat page.
pros: Custom trigger phrase in many languages
Keyboard shortcut and push-to-talk as alternatives to the voice trigger
Can show a chat view with the session history
cons: Speech features only work in Chrome, not in other Chromium-based browsers
Relies on a third-party AI service (ChatGPT)
